title: Store Postal Address

title: Store Visiting Address
description: The physical store address

description: The store's phone number.

description: The country of your store.

title: Store Zone
description: The zone of your store.

title: Store Postcode
description: The postcode of your store.

title: Store Language
description: The spoken language of your organization.

title: Store Currency
description: The currency which all prices conform to.

title: Store Weight Unit
description: The preferred weight unit.

title: Store Length Unit
description: The preferred length unit.

title: Default Language
description: The default language,if not identified.

title: Default Currency
description: The default currency,if not identified.

title: Default Country
description: The default country,if not otherwise set.

title: Default Zone
description: The default zone,if not otherwise set.

title: Default Tax Class
description: The default tax class that will be preset when creating new products.

title: Default Customer Group
description: The default customer group for new customers.

title: Default Address Format
description: The default address format if not specified otherwise.

title: Default Display Prices Including Tax
description: Display prices including tax by default.

title: Default Quantity Unit
description: The default quantity unit,if not otherwise set.

title: Default Sold Out Status
description: The default sold-out status,if not otherwise set.

title: Default Delivery Status
description: The default delivery status,if not otherwise set.

title: Default Incoterm
description: Default Incoterm for new orders if nothing else is set.

title: Default Order Status
description: Default order status for new orders if nothing else is set.

title: Default Print Paper Size
description: Default paper size used for printing.

title: Send Emails
description: Whether or not the platform should deliver outgoing emails.

title: SMTP Enabled
description: Whether or not to use an SMTP server for delivering email.

title: SMTP Host
description: SMTP hostname, e.g. smtp.myprovider.com.

title: SMTP Port
description: SMTP port, e.g. 25,465 (SSL/TLS), or 587 (STARTTLS).

title: SMTP Username
description: Username for SMTP authentication.

title: SMTP Password
description: Password for SMTP authentication.

title: Regional Settings Screen
description: Enables the regional settings screen upon first visit.

title: Enable Customer Accounts
description: Allow customers to create an account and sign in.

title: Account Verification
description: Verify customer accounts upon registration.

title: Company Field
description: Display the field for the customer's company name.

title: Tax ID Field
description: Display the field for the customer's tax ID.

title: Zone/State/Province Field
description: Display the field for the customer's zone/state.

title: Different Shipping Address
description: Allow customers to provide a different address for shipping.

title: Newsletter Subscription
description: Allow customers to subscribe to newsletter.

title: Important Notice
description: An important notice to be displayed above your website.

title: Maintenance Mode
description: Maintenance mode will enable a slash screen that the site is down for maintenance.

title: Catalog Only Mode
description: Disables the cart and checkout features leaving only a browsable catalog.

title: Items Per Page
description: The number of items to be displayed per page.

title: Data Table Rows
description: The number of data table rows to be displayed per page.

title: Display Stock Count
description: Show the available amount of products in stock.

title: Cheapest Shipping
description: Display the cheapest shipping cost on product page.

title: Max Age for New Products
description: Display the "New" sticker for products less than the given age. E.g. 1 month or 14 days

title: Similar Products Box: Number of Items
description: The maximum number of items to be displayed in the box.

title: Recently Viewed Products Box: Number of Items
description: The maximum number of items to be displayed in the box.

title: Featured Products Box: Number of Items
description: The maximum number of items to be displayed in the box.

title: Latest Products Box: Number of Items
description: The maximum number of items to be displayed in the box.

title: Popular Products Box: Number of Items
description: The maximum number of items to be displayed in the box.

title: Campaign Products Box: Number of Items
description: The maximum number of items to be displayed in the box.

title: Also Purchased Products Box: Number of Items
description: The maximum number of items to be displayed in the box.

title: Show Product Count In Category Tree
description: Show the number of products inside each category in the category tree.

title: Cookie Policy
description: Select a page for the cookie policy or leave blank to disable.

title: Privacy Policy
description: Select a page for the privacy policy consent or leave blank to disable.

title: Terms of Purchase
description: Select a page for the terms of purchase or leave blank to disable.

title: Do Not Share My Information / Opt-Out
description: Select a page for Do Not Share My Information or leave blank to disable.

title: Company Imprint / Impressum
description: Select a page for Company Imprint or leave blank to disable.

title: Clear Thumbnails Cache
description: Remove all cached image thumbnails from disk.

title: Category Images: Aspect Ratio
description: The aspect ratio of the category thumbnails

title: Category Images: Clipping Method
description: The clipping method used for scaled category thumbnails.

title: Product Images: Aspect Ratio
description: The aspect ratio of the product thumbnails

title: Product Images: Clipping Method
description: The clipping method used for scaled product thumbnails.

title: Product Images: Trim Whitespace
description: Trim whitespace before generating thumbnail images.

title: Product Images: Watermark
description: Watermark product images with the store logo.

title: Downsample
description: Downsample large uploaded images to best fit within the given dimensions of "width,height" or leave empty. Default: 2048,2048

title: Image Quality
description: The JPEG quality for uploaded images (0-100). Default: 90

title: Thumbnail Quality
description: The JPEG quality for thumbnail images (0-100). Default: 65

title: Interlaced Thumbnails
description: Generate interlaced thumbnail images for progressive loading. Increases the filesize by 10-20% but improves user experience.

title: Whitespace Color
description: Set the color of any generated whitespace to the given RGB value. Default: 255,255,255

title: AVIF Enabled
description: Use AVIF images if supported by the browser.

title: WebP Enabled
description: Use WebP images if supported by the browser.

title: Image Lazy Loading
description: Tells the browser to load images on the pages first when they are scrolled down to.

title: Send Order Confirmation
description: Send order confirmations via email.

title: BCC Order Copy Recipients
description: Send an email of the order copy to the given hidden BCC recipients. Separated by comma or semicolon.

title: Order Number Format
description: Specify the format for creating order numbers. {id} = order id, {yy} = year, {mm} = month, {q} = quarter, {l} length digit, {#} = luhn checksum digit

title: System Cache Enabled
description: Enables the system cache module which caches frequently used data.

title: Clear System Cache
description: Remove all cached system information.

title: Static Content Domain Name
description: Use the given alias domain name for static content (images, stylesheets, javascripts).

title: Control Panel Link
description: The URL to your control panel, e.g. cPanel.

title: Webmail Link
description: The URL to your webmail client.

title: CAPTCHA
description: Prevent robots from posting form data by enabling CAPTCHA security.

title: Facebook Link
description: The link to your Facebook page.

title: Instagram Link
description: The link to your Instagram page.

title: LinkedIn Link
description: The link to your LinkedIn page.

title: Pinterest Link
description: The link to your Pinterest page.

title: X Link
description: The link to your X page.

title: YouTube Link
description: The link to your YouTube channel.

title: Jobs Last Push
description: Time when background jobs were last pushed for execution.

title: Marketplace Access Token
description: The API access token for use with marketplace.
